name: Gond Ke Ladoo
instructions: 1. Heat ghee in a heavy-bottomed pan and fry the edible gum (gond) until it puffs up; remove and crush coarsely.
2. In the same ghee, roast the wheat flour on low heat until it turns golden brown and aromatic.
3. Add dry ginger powder, melon seeds, and chopped nuts to the flour and roast for a few more minutes.
4. Add the crushed fried gond to the mixture and mix well.
5. Melt jaggery with a tablespoon of ghee in a separate pan until it reaches a syrup-like consistency and pour over the dry mixture.
6. While the mixture is still warm, take small portions and shape them into round laddus using your palms.
description: Gond Ke Ladoo is a traditional Rajasthani delicacy primarily prepared during winters. It is renowned for its health benefits, particularly in keeping the body warm and providing strength to joints. It is a staple food for new mothers and is deeply rooted in the cultural traditions of Rajasthan as a nourishing energy booster.
